How to use our website

Get a price, order print online, design your own artwork, pay an invoice or sign your agreement — step by step.

Last updated October 27, 2026
On this pageGet a priceBook an appointmentOrder print onlineDesign it yourselfYour accountQuotes & invoicesSign your agreementTrack an orderChat with usSending filesMore helpFAQArtwork guidelinesWarrantyOrders, Shipping & ReturnsContact

1. Get a price

There are three ways to get a price — pick whichever is fastest for you.

  1. Vehicle wrap price estimator. Open the price estimator, choose your vehicle type and the coverage you want (decals, partial or full wrap) and you see a ballpark price straight away.
  2. Request a quote. Every service page has a quote form. Tell us what you need, add your vehicle’s year, make and model or your sizes, and attach photos or your logo. You get a reference number by email.
  3. Online shop prices. Print products (business cards, flyers, banners, signs, labels, apparel and more) show their price on the product page and update as you change size, material and quantity.

Most quotes go out within one business day. Your quote arrives by email with a link where you can review and accept it.

2. Book an appointment

  • Auto detailing: book a time directly on the booking page — choose the package, your vehicle and a date.
  • Wraps, tint and installs: we schedule the install date with you after your quote is approved. Drop-off times and preparation steps are in your quote and agreement.
  • Shop visits are by appointment — contact us and we will set a time.

3. Order print online

  1. Open the Print shop, Apparel or the Shop and choose a product.
  2. Choose the size, material, finish and quantity. The price updates as you go.
  3. Add your artwork: upload a print-ready file, design it yourself in Design Studio, or choose our design service.
  4. Add it to your cart and check out. You can pay securely by card or PayPal. Have a coupon code? Enter it at checkout.
  5. Our team checks every file before production and contacts you if anything needs fixing. You get emails as your order moves from artwork check to in production to ready.

4. Design it yourself in Design Studio

Design Studio is our free online editor for print, apparel and vehicle graphics.

  1. Pick a product — business cards, flyers, banners, signs, T-shirts, hoodies, a pickup, van or minivan and more. Your canvas is already the right size.
  2. Start from a template or a blank canvas. Add text in dozens of fonts, upload your logo and photos, and add shapes.
  3. Arrange everything. Drag to move, use the corner handles to resize and the side handles to stretch. Click a selected item again to rotate it. You can also flip, mirror and turn items from the menu.
  4. Undo anything with the Undo and Redo buttons, or Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y (⌘ on a Mac).
  5. Vehicles: each side of the vehicle is a separate view. Turn on Design on the windows too if you want graphics on the glass (perforated window film).
  6. T-shirts: press 3D view to see your design on a shirt and turn it around.
  7. Save or submit. Your design is saved in your account. When you are happy, submit it — our team reviews it, sends you a proof and a price, and nothing is printed before you approve.
Tip: you need a free account to save designs and submit vehicle designs. If you are not signed in, Design Studio asks you to sign in before submitting — your work is kept.

5. Your account

  1. Choose Create an account (or Log in) and confirm your email address.
  2. In My account you will find:
    • Orders — everything you ordered online and where it is in production.
    • Saved designs — your Design Studio designs; open one to keep editing.
    • Invoices — your invoices, what is paid and what is still due.
    • Quotes & bookings — the requests you sent us and their status.
    • Profile — your name, phone, address and password.

6. Quotes and invoices

  • Quotes arrive by email with a link. Open it to see every line, then press Accept quote (or let us know what to change).
  • Invoices arrive the same way. Open the link to view or download the PDF and to pay online by card or PayPal. Your payment is recorded on the invoice right away.
  • Deposits: larger projects are paid in parts, for example a deposit before production and the balance at pickup. The invoice shows each payment and its due date — pay each part from the same link.
  • You can also pay in person at the shop. Ask us about other payment options.

7. Sign your agreement online

For wraps and other installs we send a service agreement to sign online — no printing or scanning.

  1. Open the link in the email.
  2. Fill in your details and your vehicle. If the job covers more than one vehicle, add each one.
  3. Read the agreement — the price, deposit and dates are already filled in by our team.
  4. Sign once at the end — draw your signature with your finger or mouse.
  5. You and our team both receive the signed PDF by email.

8. Track an order or request

Go to Track, enter the reference from your confirmation email (order number or request reference) and the email you used. If you have an account, everything is also in My account.

9. Chat with us

Use the chat bubble at the bottom corner of any page. Our assistant answers common questions instantly — prices, hours, materials, how things work — and you can ask for a person at any time. If we are away, leave your message and email address and we reply as soon as we are back.

10. Sending files

Upload files on the product page, in Design Studio or with the quote form. Print-ready PDF and vector files (AI, EPS, SVG) give the best result. For very large files, add a WeTransfer, Dropbox or Google Drive link in your notes. See our artwork guidelines for sizes, bleed and resolution.

Still stuck? Contact us or call (905) 695-9147 — we’ll help within one business day. Read the FAQ.
